_why: The Executive Summary versions ITSELF. Until r1.002 the page took its label from the living document's release counter, so it read v.19 r1.006 — a number that moves whenever the DOCUMENT changes and tells a reader nothing about the text in front of them. The operator's correction: 'this version is the default for executive summary, if easier maybe this should be r1.002'. Append an edition when the text changes; never renumber one that has shipped.

editions.note: First edition — Executive Summary to Humanity. The 1 + 12 deep dive: Preamble, twelve sections and a close, in plain international English.

Final approved text. The three-term hierarchy is now stated rather than implied — Thought Mastery the discipline, a Thought Master the person, Master of Thought the responsibility behind both. Vision • 2525 throughout. Master of Thought is responsibility rather than rank; that distinction is fundamental. The seal caption no longer claims cuneiform is the oldest writing we still have. Source filenames are out of the visible prose.
